thread:
anya: Quick sync — pricing/packaging rollout: I want a final owners + blocker check for metering, billing schema, quota flags, and contract constraints. Can everyone confirm ownership and ETA?

alex: I can own the metering adapter changes (transform + delta metrics). PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/meters/pull/89. ETA Wed EOD. Need test vectors for license quota edgecases.

marie: Billing side needs a mapping change to invoice v2. PR: #345 (billing-service). Waiting on contract constraints definition from contract team before we wire the flag.

prashant: Contract team question: do we enforce quota checks at billing-time or pre-authorize at request-time? This affects db schema. tagging @bill for legal/contract semantics.

sophia: For rollout ops: propose canary Fri 10:00 PDT in us-west-2 for 2h, then gradual 25/50/100. I’ll run the canary and watch cost/latency. Any objections? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline passed for branch pricing-packaging/v2 (build 4218) :white_check_mark:

bill: Looping in legal. We need to define "quota_exempt" and whether contracts can set per-customer overages. Legal expects a short spec doc. I can get an initial draft by Thu EOB.

anya: Thanks — two concrete asks: alex add test vectors to fixtures; marie prepare interim mapping to avoid breakage; prashant if contract team prefers pre-auth we may need a new quota table.

alex: Added tests at tests/fixtures/pricing_licenses.json and unit coverage. Also added an integration toggle: `FEATURE_FLAGS.license_quota_v2 = true`.

marie: I can ship interim mapping (backwards compatible) in PR #346. If contract constraints change, we'll patch mapping in follow-up.

prashant: If we do pre-auth, we need a new table `quota_allocations` and a small API:
```
POST /quota/allocate
{ customer_id, operation, tokens_requested }
-> 200 { allocation_id, allowed }
```
That adds ~2 days dev + migration.

anya: Noted. If legal needs Thurs for wording, schedule-wise that pushes pre-auth to next week. Can we scope a fallback where billing rejects overage and logs for now?

bill: Legal ok with fallback for now (reject + log). Will send spec with examples by Thu.

sophia: Canary schedule locked for Fri 10:00 PDT with fallback to previous model. I'll post calendar invite and runbook.

alex: Ping on code review please @marie @prashant — meter PR needs one more approval to merge.

marie: Reviewing now, left one comment about rounding in invoice mapping.

prashant: Left contract-related nit in alex's PR about flag name. Suggest `contract_constraints.enforce_quota` instead of `enforce_quota_owner`.

anya: OK — decision: use `contract_constraints.enforce_quota`. alex update and we merge. People, if you can't make your ETA, reply in-thread. I'll update milestone board after lunch. :thumbsup:

alex: Updated flag name + pushed. All green from my side.

marie: Merged billing interim mapping PR #346.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2961180000 (Fri 10:00 PDT) — will trigger automated rollback on >=5% error rate.

anya: Great work team. I'll follow up with a short rollup to PMs + infra. If legal posts the spec early, we can opt-in pre-auth next week.

bill: will ping when spec is live.

anya: Closing this thread for now — leave any follow-ups here and I’ll surface them in the milestone doc.
